context: Tests whether the agent produces a final review report matching the required markdown format — including the correct heading structure, per-finding severity tags, file references, before/after code descriptions, skip reasons, and a verdict line — and removes the temporary working directory after completion.

checklist.name: ## Review Report heading
checklist.description: The report starts with exactly '## Review Report' as a level-2 heading

checklist.name: Iterations count shown
checklist.description: The report includes a bold '**Iterations:** N' line showing the number of iterations run

checklist.name: Finding heading with severity
checklist.description: Each finding has a heading in the format '### Finding N — [P-severity]' (e.g., [P1-critical], [P2-high]) with a severity tag in square brackets

checklist.name: Fixed or skipped in heading
checklist.description: Each finding heading includes '(fixed)' or '(skipped)' to indicate the outcome

checklist.name: File field in each finding
checklist.description: Each finding section has a '**File:**' field showing the filename and line number(s)

checklist.name: Issue field in each finding
checklist.description: Each finding section has an '**Issue:**' field with a description of what was found and why it matters

checklist.name: Resolution field in each finding
checklist.description: Each finding section has a '**Resolution:**' field describing what was done or why it was skipped

checklist.name: Before/after for fixed items
checklist.description: Fixed items include a before/after description in the Resolution field (e.g., 'was: X, now: Y')

checklist.name: Skip reason for skipped items
checklist.description: Skipped items include an explicit reason in the Resolution field (false positive, design decision, or out of scope)

checklist.name: Verdict line present
checklist.description: The report ends with '### Verdict: clean' or '### Verdict: has remaining items'

checklist.name: Temp dir cleanup
checklist.description: The workflow includes 'rm -rf' of the temporary review directory at the end, OR the temporary directory no longer exists after the process
